{"metadata":{"description":"Session progress tracking for DeepSeek Harness: a live nested checklist with per-item weights, a progress ring in the composer, and a native right sidebar panel.","id":"gh:1364561149","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-session-progress","slug":"nguyenduclong-ict/dsh-session-progress","topics":["agent-progress","ai-agent","checklist","cordis","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-desktop","dsh-plugin","progress-tracker","session-progress","task-tracking"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Session progress tracking for DeepSeek Harness: a live nested checklist with per-item weights, a pro"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"gress ring in the composer, and a native right sidebar panel."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-session-progress"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | Tiếng Việt"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## 1. Purpose & Overview"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Know how far a long agent session has actually got — without digging through the logs.** `dsh-sess"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ion-progress` is a real-time session progress and task tracking plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH /"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" DSH Desktop)**: the agent keeps a live checklist of the work, the completion percentage is computed"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" from the ticked boxes, and each session stores it as a single JSON progress document."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Topics: DSH plugin · DeepSeek Harness · session progress · weighted checklist · task tracking · JSON"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" · DeepSeek Harness · session progress · weighted checklist · task tracking · JSON progress document"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Both images are rendered from the plugin's own HTML/CSS by npm run shots."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"In long-running or complex agentic sessions it is hard to tell the overall completion status, the su"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"btask running right now, or what comes next without sifting through a long conversation log. This pl"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ugin keeps that answer one click away:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **A live checklist instead of a guess** — the agent writes what it is doing as weighted tasks, nes"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ted from a whole phase down to a single step, and ticks them off as it goes.
- **A percentage that a"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"lways matches reality** — the ring and the `%` pill in the composer dock row are computed from the b"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"oxes (done `1` · running `½` · pending `0`), so nobody does the arithmetic and the agent never write"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"s a number.
- **A panel, not a log** — the **Session Progress** tab in DSH's own right sidebar shows"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" the goal, the weighted checklist with each item's share, the current activity, the next steps and t"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"he working notes.
- **Prose that reads at a glance** — Overview, Current Activity, Next Steps and Ke"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"y Findings / Notes are **Markdown**: the agent lays the state out as one fact per line, `-` bullets,"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" backticks around a path or command, or a small table, instead of one wall of text.
- **A record whe"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"n the session ends** — the same file stands as a clean summary of what got done, and a v0.10.x Markd"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"own progress file is migrated to JSON automatically on first read."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### How it appears"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The plugin renders **inside DSH's own right sidebar** — it does not draw an overlay of its own, so i"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"t never fights the frame for space:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Surface | Where it lives |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Progress ring + `%` pill | The composer **dock row under the input card**, beside the context mete"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"r (hidden until a session exists) |
| Progress panel | A native right sidebar tab named **Session Pr"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"until a session exists) |
| Progress panel | A native right sidebar tab named **Session Progress** |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Clicking the composer control (or the *Click to open the progress panel* hint in its popover) opens "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"that tab and reveals the right column. Being an ordinary sidebar tab, it docks, floats, splits, and "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"follows the session exactly like Files or the document preview."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> **Requirement**: the right sidebar tab slots (`rightbar.session`, `sidebar.right.pane.tab`) must e"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"xist in your DSH build — DSH Desktop 0.9.0 or newer.
>
> **Compatibility note (v0.11.1)**: progress "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"is now stored as a **JSON document** instead of Markdown, and the checklist is a **nested, weighted "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"tree**. Every item declares a `weight`, so the percentage on the ring is *computed* from the boxes —"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" the agent never writes a number again. A v0.10.x Markdown progress file is migrated to JSON automat"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ically the first time its session is read, checklist included. The composer trigger is hidden on the"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" new-conversation screen (there is nothing to report yet), and the panel sections are drawn with the"},{"id":"p15s8","text":" original accent-bar headings.
>
> **Compatibility note (v0.10.6)**: DSH Desktop 0.10.0 (harness 0.1"},{"id":"p15s9","text":".7) renamed the session id source and prefixed session ids with `session-`. The client now reads the"},{"id":"p15s10","text":" current session through `uiSession` and the host accepts either id spelling, while the 0.9.x/0.10.0"},{"id":"p15s11","text":" shapes both stay supported."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 2. The progress document"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"One JSON file per session (`dsh-progress-<session>-<uuid>.json`, in the system temp directory) holds"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" the whole document:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### How the percentage is computed"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`weight` is an item's share **among its siblings**, normalized so every group is worth 100%:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Both readings of the example above therefore agree: three top-level weights (`20 / 30 / 50`, i.e. pe"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"rcent of the job) and two sub-weights (`25 / 25`, summing to their parent's `50`). An item with no w"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"eight counts as `1`, and a group may not mix declared and defaulted child weights."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Progress of a node: a leaf counts `1` when `done`, `½` when `running`, `0` when `pending`; a group i"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"s the weighted average of its children and its own `state` is derived — checking a group off cascade"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"s `done` into its whole subtree. `status` is derived too (all leaves done ⇒ `completed`, any progres"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"s ⇒ `in_progress`, nothing started ⇒ `starting`); `blocked` is the only status a caller sets."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Agent-facing tools"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| `session_progress_status` | Cheapest first look of a turn: the current activity, the step in progr"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ess, the pending steps after it and the plan. |
| `session_progress_check_done` | Finish the step in"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" progress: tick it, promote the next `[ ]` step to running, recompute the percentage. |
| `session_p"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"rogress_write` | Create the document (`content`) or patch it (`checklist` + `checklist_mode`, `add`,"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" `update`, `check`, `start`, `uncheck`, `remove`, and the prose fields). |
| `session_progress_read`"},{"id":"p26s6","text":" | Read the whole document, or only the sections you name. |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"No tool accepts a percentage — it always follows the boxes."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Good to know"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Weights are normalized, so re-weighting one item changes its siblings' shares. Read `weightPercent"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"` back from `session_progress_read` / `session_progress_status` when an exact split matters.
- An it"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"em may nest up to 6 levels; a document holds at most 400 items and should stay under ~40 KB.
- A mat"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"cher (`#3` = displayed row, `#2.1` = path, or a text snippet) must resolve to exactly one item. An u"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"nknown or ambiguous matcher is refused, with the full item list, and nothing is written.
- The panel"},{"id":"p29s6","text":" prints each item's computed share as a `%` badge, so a declared weight and the number on screen can"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"m's computed share as a `%` badge, so a declared weight and the number on screen can never disagree."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## 3.
